# Code Anchors: Config Write-Back

- `libs/delivery-config/src/write.ts` — the add-only merge itself: it adds absent keys only, skips and reports every key the hub layer supplies, never rewrites a declared value, never writes an empty one, targets the given root without walking to an ancestor, and creates the configuration directory and file when they are absent.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/write.spec.ts` — writer coverage: the freshly created block, the untouched declared key, the no-change report, the byte-identical survival of other sections and comments, and the given-root targeting.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/config-cli.ts` — the command surface the attended producer drives, including the comment written above a freshly created block and the line naming keys left to the hub; its flag list is deliberately the bootstrap subset rather than the whole catalogue.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/keys.ts` — the derived inverse this writer translates the resolver's names back through, so a key it can resolve is a key it can seed.
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — the attended producer: in a member, probes only keys that resolve to nothing; detects classification, lists candidate projects and asks when several match, falls back to safe values with a recorded reason when the tooling is unreachable, and reports the seeded block for review.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — surfaces the unattended seed in its completion report, so the uncommitted config change is reviewed and committed.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/run.ts` — the unattended producer on the epic-filing path, recording its first-run decisions through the shared writer.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/writeback.ts`, `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/run.ts` — the unattended producer on the story-filing path, writing through the same writer.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/hub-inheritance.spec.ts` — covers that neither producer copies a hub-supplied key into a member's settings.
